title: Origin샤드의 캐릭이동서비스 연기일정
bodyHtml:
유저들의 의견을 수렴하여 2005년 6월 14일경으로 연기 되었습니다.


Character Transfer and Advanced Characters on Origin delayed Jan 15 2005 1:54AM CST (GMT -06:00)  
The UO team would like to thank you for your feedback regarding Character Transfers and Advanced Characters on the Origin shard. We are happy to announce that due to popular demand, we're going to extend the moratorium on both services for the Origin shard by approximately five months. They will now be activated on Tuesday, June 14th 2005.  


출처 : http://www.uo.com/news.html
